BETA Close X RS Group plc has purchased 700,500 ordinary shares for cancellation as part of its £100 million share repurchase program, with the latest transactions occurring between June 1 and June 5, 2026. Following these purchases, the company will have 473,348,968 ordinary shares in issue, resulting in a total of 473,348,968 voting rights. Disclaimer* RS Group PLC 08 June 2026 RS Group plc 8 June 2026 Transaction in Own Shares RS Group plc (the "Company") announces that in the week 1 June 2026 to 5 June 2026, it purchased for cancellation the following number of its ordinary shares of 10 pence each (Ordinary Shares) through Barclays Bank plc, as part of its £100 million share repurchase programme announced on 20 May 2026 (the "Programme"). All Ordinary Shares were purchased from Barclays Bank plc as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange. Following the above purchases and cancellation of these Ordinary Shares, the Company will have 473,348,968 Ordinary Shares in issue, with no shares held in treasury. Therefore, the total number of voting rights in the Company is 473,348,968. This announcement is made in accordance with the requirements of UK Listing Rule 9.6.6.
